title: Delivery platforms and terms
subtitle: The Deliverect accounts, each delivery platform's credit customer, and the contract terms in force on each date.

access.deniedTitle: No access to delivery platforms and terms
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the Deliverect terms grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

accounts.title: Deliverect accounts
accounts.hint: Read only. A store is onboarded on one of these accounts.
accounts.failed: The accounts could not be loaded

platforms.title: Delivery platforms
platforms.failed: The delivery platforms could not be loaded

edit.title: Edit the delivery platform
edit.note: The credit customer is the SAP customer this platform's orders are invoiced to.
edit.creditCustomerHint: Leave empty if the platform has none yet.
edit.activeBlocked: A platform with no credit customer cannot be active: its orders would be refused.

problems.noCreditCustomer: Untick Active, or enter a credit customer.

addPlatform.title: Add a delivery platform
addPlatform.platformKeyHint: Letters, digits, _ or -, at most 26 (for example JAHEZ). It cannot change once added.

problems.keyFormat: Use letters, digits, _ or -, at most 26.

timeline.title: Terms
timeline.hint: Rows are never edited: a correction is a new row.
timeline.pick: Pick a delivery platform to see its terms.
timeline.failed: The terms could not be loaded
timeline.empty: No terms yet for this delivery platform.

add.title: Add terms
add.neverEdited: Terms are never edited: a correction is a new row.
add.closesOn: The current terms, valid from <from>{{from}}</from>, close on <closeOn>{{closeOn}}</closeOn>, the day before the new row starts.
add.closesDayBefore: The current terms close the day before the new row starts.
add.first: These are the platform's first terms. They stay open until the next row is added.

conflict.inside: <date>{{date}}</date> falls inside the terms valid from <from>{{from}}</from>. The server will refuse an overlap.
conflict.insideOpen: <date>{{date}}</date> is the day the current terms start. A new row must start after it.
conflict.before: <date>{{date}}</date> comes before the terms valid from <from>{{from}}</from>. A new row must start after the latest one.

problems.number: Enter a number, at most 3 decimals.
